arguments.value: User needs a brief support-ticket summary only. They want Linux tc guidance to share a 100 Mbps server link fairly among up to 10 simultaneous download clients with dynamic IPs: one client should be able to use all bandwidth, while multiple clients should split it roughly equally, with a guaranteed 10 Mbps per client. They provided an HTB tc example but said it only limits total throughput to 10 Mbps when two clients download.
